answer_1.quote: We propose two new tasks, pun explanation and keyword-conditioned pun generation, to showcase novel tasks that our dataset uniquely enables and push the frontiers of NLU and NLG for humor.
answer_1.outputs: natural language explanations of why a pun is funny and generated pun sentences conditioned on keywords

answer_2.quote: We use both automatic metrics and human evaluation to evaluate the quality of generated puns. For automatic evaluation, we calculate word incorporation rate for both pun words and keywords, ... we compute averaged BLEU-4 and METEOR scores in a pairwise fashion.

answer_4.quote: We use human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk, in which we asked Turkers to label whether or not a given generated pun was successful.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers were asked to label whether the generated pun was successful (i.e., supports both senses of the pun word).
criteria: success (supports both senses of the pun word)
